structure: Single-grade document (Grade 1, 2023 format). Pages 2-3: context/purpose, acknowledgments (backup); the examples sentence is split across pages 2-3 (u11, u14). Page 4 onward: one table with four domains (History, Civics and Government, Geography, Economics); each domain has a heading row, a Learning Outcome row, then standard rows with C1 = code (1.H.n, 1.C.n, 1.G.n, 1.E.n) and C2 = standard text, often with an inline '● Examples: ...' list in the same unit; '(E)' marks essential standards.
